summary: First full test run of AEGIS (React CRA + FastAPI). Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (health, /api/zerog/status, /api/agent/think SSE plain + action extraction + follow-up events, 422 validation, /api/worldid/verify valid/0xdead/missing fields). Frontend at 1920px: landing headline + Launch Agent works; console empty state, suggestions, composer, thinking indicator, streaming reply, inference badge with a 0g-req id and expandable details all work. Human Gate: approve (scan, verified, close, 'World ID verified · executed' + follow-up), deny ('Denied by human' + abort reply), cancel button, X button and Escape ('Verification cancelled'), simulate invalid proof ('Verification failed.' -> 'Proof rejected'), and expiry with a 15s timeout ('Verification expired') all work. Read-only lookup is auto-approved with no modal. Blocking transaction+payment gives 'Blocked by policy' with no modal. A critical irreversible action is still gated under Operator. The policy page works: presets change the sidebar mode, rules switch to Custom, irreversible-auto is disabled, the simulator updates and the policy hash changes. Audit filters, empty state and JSON export work. Identity page works: profile persists, World ID toggle syncs to the sidebar, 0G shows Connected, verification history shows items, wipe clears data. Messages and audit log persist after reload. ONE HIGH BUG: route transitions in AppShell sometimes get stuck. After using the Policy page (reliably after clicking a preset), clicking another sidebar nav link changes the URL but the main area stays blank or blurred and the new page never mounts.

minor.issue: No nullifier single-use enforcement, and any proof not starting with 0xdead is accepted. Expected for demo mode but worth noting.

ui_bugs.component: AppShell route transition (components/AppShell.jsx lines 78-84: AnimatePresence mode='wait' keyed by location.pathname)
ui_bugs.issue: Navigation gets stuck and the page stays blank. Repro: open /app/policy, click policy-preset-balanced (or any preset), wait 1.5s, click nav-console. The URL becomes /app but the Policy subtree never finishes exiting and Console never mounts: a blank or blurred main area, composer-input never appears, and only a full reload recovers. Reproduced 3 times. It also happened once after clicking policy-rule-transaction-deny and policy-rule-payment-deny, then nav-console. Likely cause: the exiting subtree has shared-layout motion elements (layoutId='preset-glow' in Policy.jsx Presets, and nav-glow in the sidebar), and these stop framer-motion 11.18 AnimatePresence mode='wait' from completing the exit.
identity-wipe-btn wipes all messages, audit, policy and profile immediately with no confirmation step (no AlertDialog). This is destructive and irreversible.

issues: The timestamp column is too narrow: '02:27:2' is clipped (seconds cut off) and 'PM' wraps to its own line. Widen the column or use whitespace-nowrap or a shorter format.
Switching filters plays overlapping layout animations, so entries briefly overlap each other.
The suggestion rows are cramped: the category label column takes up the width, so the suggestion text wraps one word per line. Stack the label above the text on mobile.
When the last message's inference-badge details are expanded, the panel opens under the composer and the list does not scroll it into view.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the stuck route transition in AppShell.jsx. Options: drop mode='wait' (or use mode='popLayout'), or wrap with LayoutGroup, or replace the motion.span layoutId='preset-glow' in Policy.jsx (and possibly nav-glow) with plain elements. Re-verify: click a preset on /app/policy, then click nav-console; the Console must render.
Add a confirmation dialog (shadcn AlertDialog) before identity-wipe-btn clears all local data.
Fix the clipped timestamps in the Audit timeline (column width / whitespace-nowrap).
Improve the layout of the mobile suggestion rows.
critical_code_review_comments: AegisContext.handleAction and resolveGate call runInference(messagesRef.current, ...) right after patchMessage. messagesRef only updates in a useEffect after render, so the history sent to the LLM can still show the old action status (or none). The event prompt covers this, but the transcript is stale.
HumanGateModal: if policy.gateTimeout changes while a gate is open, the timeout prop changes but `left` does not reset, so the progress ratio is off. Minor.

runInference is a useCallback with an empty deps array (eslint-disabled) and calls handleAction from the first render's closure. This works today only because everything goes through refs or stable setters, so it is fragile.
The composer textarea stays enabled while the agent is busy (only the send button is disabled). This is fine, but Enter-to-send should also respect busy (not verified).
Unlinking World ID on the Identity page does not change gating behaviour. Consider blocking gate approval when World ID is not linked.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows pass; nav transition bug intermittent/high)

test_credentials: No auth in app; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty placeholder (expected).
seed_data_creation: None. All data is browser-local (IndexedDB/localStorage) in ephemeral Playwright contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call starts a fresh browser context, so test persistence with page.reload() inside the same script. Testid indexes for message-agent-N and action-card-N use the message's index in the list (user=0, agent=1, follow-up=2...). The LLM categorises the ETH transfer as 'payment' (so Guardian gates it). Radix slider: focus [role=slider] and press Home to get 15s. Use page.goto rather than sidebar nav after policy edits until the AnimatePresence bug is fixed. The landing-to-/app transition was fine on retest (an early screenshot that showed a shifted sidebar was mid-animation and did not reproduce).
rca of the issue: Stuck navigation: AppShell wraps the outlet in <AnimatePresence mode='wait'> keyed by pathname. In mode='wait' the next route mounts only after the exiting child's exit animation completes. The Policy page contains a shared-layout element (motion.span layoutId='preset-glow'), and the sidebar NavLink's layoutId='nav-glow' moves at the same moment. In framer-motion 11 the shared-layout projection can stop the exit-complete callback from firing, so the old route stays in the DOM, faded and blurred, forever. Repro: /app/policy, click policy-preset-balanced, wait 1.5s, click nav-console. Result: URL is /app, the main area is blank, and document.querySelector('[data-testid=composer-input]') is null indefinitely.
